name: Himali Kharkar
player_statement:
A complete player, Himali Kharkar has made a big mark in cricket. With 5 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 36*, with an average of 19.00 and a quick strike rate of 129.55. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 4 sixes and 4 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 7.5 overs, taking 4 wickets at an economy rate of 3.70. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
